# Tool Analysis: Search CMS Pages

## Step Analysis
The recorded steps show an agent attempting to demonstrate CMS page search and filtering functionality in Magento admin. The agent:
1. Navigated to the CMS pages management URL
2. Encountered a login page (session issue) and logged in with admin credentials
3. Analyzed the page structure to identify filter controls
4. Attempted multiple times to interact with filter inputs (Title, URL Key, Status)
5. Extracted detailed information about available filter controls

## Task Definition
Create a tool to search and filter CMS pages in Magento admin using various criteria including:
- Page title (text search)
- URL key (text search) 
- Status (Enabled/Disabled dropdown)
- Layout (dropdown)
- Store view (multi-select dropdown)
- Date created range (From/To)
- Last modified range (From/To)

## Action Plan
1. Navigate to CMS pages management page
2. Wait for page to load (timing issue from previous failure)
3. Input search criteria into filter fields
4. Click Search button to apply filters
5. Extract search results

## Variable Identification
Based on the extracted page structure and form field names:
1. `title` - Page title filter (text input, name="title")
2. `identifier` - URL key filter (text input, name="identifier")  
3. `is_active` - Status filter (dropdown, values: "1"=Enabled, "0"=Disabled)
4. `root_template` - Layout filter (dropdown)
5. `store_id` - Store view filter (multi-select dropdown)
6. `created_at[from]` - Date created from filter (date input)
7. `created_at[to]` - Date created to filter (date input)
8. `updated_at[from]` - Last modified from filter (date input)
9. `updated_at[to]` - Last modified to filter (date input)

## Step Optimization
- Use agent steps for dynamic content interaction (previous attempts showed timing/element selection issues)
- Add explicit wait step to handle page loading
- Use elementHash where available for stable element targeting
- Focus on essential search/filter functionality only (no optional demo steps)
